name: 眨眨岛 · 自然绘本 Tripo 场景
objective: Create the complete refreshed natural-storybook 3D asset set with Tripo only. Preserve the current functioning native app until this independent package is reviewed. Retain clear silhouettes and measured mobile XR budgets.

subjects.description: A floating miniature island terrain with a rounded cream rock underside and a soft sage grassy top; no pre-baked trees or butterfly.
subjects.generationPrompt: Isolated floating miniature island terrain, one self-contained object. Rounded layered cream limestone underside, softly undulating sage-green grassy top with a shallow turquoise water inlet. Refined natural storybook diorama, matte hand-painted colors, smooth readable silhouette, soft cream and mint palette. Geometry contains terrain and inset water only. Centered, complete, unobstructed.

subjects.description: A reusable softly rounded tree for the right-hand island.
subjects.generationPrompt: Isolated miniature broadleaf tree as one self-contained object. Refined natural storybook diorama, matte hand-painted texture, readable organic silhouette with gentle asymmetry, compact rooted base. Centered, complete, unobstructed.

materials.description: Cream #F6F5E9, sage, mint and restrained turquoise; matte hand-painted appearance with soft organic variation. Preserve provider-authored materials and inspect consistency.

composition.description: The island scenery is entirely to the viewer's right of center at eye level. Trees, flower patches and pebbles sit on the island. Keep the left native control panel volume and central training area unobstructed. Assemble butterfly body and two mirrored independently addressable wings as a separate reusable target asset; the native app will own flapping and flight animation after import.
relationships: CanopyTree, FlowerPatch and PebbleCluster are supported by IslandBase.
ButterflyWing instances are left and right children of ButterflyBody with independent pivot parents.
Native UI and training routes are not model geometry.

lighting.description: Soft neutral-warm environment illumination suitable for viewing matte cream and mint surfaces; no baked hard shadows or flashing effects.
